description.title: תקופות זמן - טיפול בפניות ובתביעות
description.summary: This table details timeframes for handling claims and public inquiries as outlined in a circular letter. It specifies the number of days allowed for various activities, such as requesting information or providing responses.
description.embed_passage: This table details timeframes for handling claims and public inquiries as outlined in a circular letter. It specifies the number of days allowed for various activities, such as requesting information or providing responses. The table is relevant to the "Settlement of claims and handling of public inquiries" circular. For example, there are 14 business days to provide information about the existence of a policy, and 30 days to respond to a public inquiry. For a senior citizen, the response time for a public inquiry is reduced to 21 days. The activities include requesting additional information, transferring a copy of a judgment, and providing information about the existence of a policy.
description.column_axis: Activity, Date or period set down in the circular letter
notable_values: Demand for additional information and documents: 14 business days
Delivery of a notice regarding the claim clarification process: 30 days
Delivery of a notice regarding continued clarification: Every 90 days
Delivery of a change notice regarding reduction of payments: 30-60 days
Transfer of a copy of a judgment: 14 business days
Provision of information regarding the existence of a policy: 14 business days
Notice to the insured regarding a third-party demand: 7 business days
Written response to public inquiry: 30 days (21 for senior citizens)
